hooks.command: terminal-notifier -message 'Claude needs your attention' -title 'Claude Code' -sound Glass && say 'Claude needs permission'
terminal-notifier -message 'Task completed' -title 'Claude Code Complete' -sound Glass && say 'Claude finished'

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); short_dir=$(echo "$dir" | sed "s|^$HOME|~|"); branch=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ''); usage=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.current_usage'); if [ "$usage" != "null" ]; then current=$(echo "$usage" | jq '.input_tokens + .cache_creation_input_tokens + .cache_read_input_tokens'); size=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.context_window_size'); pct=$((current * 100 / size)); else pct=0; fi; printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m | \033[33m%s\033[0m | \033[35m%d%%\033[0m | \033[32m%s\033[0m' "$short_dir" "$branch" "$pct" "$model"
